30th Celebration: Classic Collection

Released September 16, 2026 · 30 cards

StandardExpanded

30th Celebration: Classic Collection is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on September 16, 2026. It has 30 cards. It includes 27 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

16 illustrators worked on 30th Celebration: Classic Collection. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (6), Ken Sugimori (5), Mitsuhiro Arita (4), Eske Yoshinob (2), Noriko Takaya, Shinji Higuchi (2), Atsuko Nishida (1), Hideki Ishikawa (1), Hironobu Yoshida (1).
